scenes.spoken_text: Assemble the project drawings, quantities, approval sequence and inspection records, distinguishing a teaching takeoff from purchasing and execution approval.
scenes.caption: Assemble the project drawings, quantities, approval sequence and inspection records, distinguishing a teaching takeoff from purchasing and execution approval.

scenes.spoken_text: Index plans, elevations, sections, interfaces and product/material/quantity schedules. Give items identifiers, sources, revisions and approval statuses, reconciling them across documents. Identify work outside the furniture scope and its owner. Completeness means consistent, actionable inputs rather than a large page count.
scenes.caption: Consistent IDs, revisions and ownership make the package usable.

scenes.spoken_text: Exercise only: a rectangular floor measures 2 m by 3 m with no deductions, so 2 × 3 = 6 m². This is a geometric takeoff, not a recommended bathroom size or final order. Purchasing also reviews product layout, cuts, pack sizes and an approved allowance. Link cost to unit rate, source and date; keep net area separate from additions.
scenes.caption: 6 m² net under the assumption; purchasing is a separate review.

scenes.display_title: Tie the sequence to inspections and handover
scenes.spoken_text: Link confirmed products and specialist coordination to approved stages and required pre-concealment inspections, then close/finish according to the selected system. Do not impose one layer sequence on all products. Assign an owner and acceptance evidence to each hold point, followed by defects, reinspection, as-built information and operation/maintenance records. Keep outstanding items visible at handover.
scenes.caption: Required evidence controls release of the next stage.

scenes.spoken_text: The 6 m² teaching takeoff is entered directly as a purchase order before packs and cutting layout are reviewed. Retain 6 m² as net takeoff and hold the order quantity and cost until product selection, layout and a dated quotation are resolved. Decision: keep takeoff and order quantity separate.
scenes.caption: Decision: keep takeoff and order quantity separate.
